label: Fade In
summary: The layer fades up from transparent over half a second.

label: Fade Out
summary: The layer fades down to transparent over half a second.

label: Wipe In from Left
summary: A soft edge sweeps across from the left and reveals the layer.

label: Wipe In from Right
summary: A soft edge sweeps across from the right and reveals the layer.

label: Wipe In from Top
summary: The layer is revealed from the top edge downwards.

label: Wipe In from Bottom
summary: The layer is revealed from the bottom edge upwards.

label: Diagonal Sweep In
summary: A wide, very soft edge sweeps in from the bottom-left corner.

label: Wipe Out to Right
summary: A soft edge travels left to right and takes the layer away.

label: Clock Reveal
summary: A clock hand sweeps once around the centre and reveals the layer.

label: Fan Open
summary: The layer opens like a fan, from the top down both sides.

label: Clock Wipe Out
summary: A clock hand sweeps once around the centre and removes the layer.

label: Blinds Open
summary: Vertical slats widen until the layer is whole.

label: Slats Down
summary: Horizontal slats thicken until the layer is whole.

label: Blinds Close
summary: Vertical slats narrow until the layer is gone.

label: Pixel Dissolve In
summary: Small hard-edged blocks pop in at random until the layer is whole.

label: Mosaic Fade In
summary: Large soft tiles fade in at random.

label: Pixel Dissolve Out
summary: Small hard-edged blocks drop out at random until the layer is gone.

label: Card Flip In
summary: A grid of cards turns over, left to right, to show the layer.

label: Card Flip Out
summary: A grid of cards turns over, left to right, and the layer is gone.

label: Grid Doors In
summary: Tiles open like small doors from the centre outwards.

label: Lens Pop In
summary: The layer grows out of a circle that stretches the picture outwards.

label: Line Sweep In
summary: A stepped, slanted edge sweeps in from the lower left.

label: Jaws Close In
summary: Toothed edges close in from the top and bottom until the layer is whole.

label: Soft Gradient Drift
summary: Four soft colour corners slowly drift around the frame.

label: Aurora Veil
summary: Tall green curtains of light ripple slowly across a night sky.

label: Slow Fog
summary: Heavy grey-blue fog banks roll gently through the frame.

label: Cloud Bank
summary: Soft cumulus clouds drift across a blue sky.

label: Dark Smoke
summary: Thick dark smoke rises slowly and curls as it goes.

label: Ember Haze
summary: A warm glowing haze of embers, black to deep red to amber.

label: Magma Flow
summary: Fire-coloured plasma that slowly cycles through its palette.

label: Ice Flow
summary: Cold blue and white veins drift through a frozen field.

label: Pastel Plasma
summary: Soft pastel plasma with colours that endlessly cycle.

label: Cell Drift
summary: Bubble-like cells slowly swell and merge in teal tones.

label: Crystal Facets
summary: Sharp crystal facets shimmer in warm violet light.

label: Hex Mosaic
summary: A hexagon mosaic that glows as fog passes beneath it.

label: Mirrored Silk
summary: Flowing silk ribbons mirrored down the centre.

label: Water Caustics
summary: Bright caustic filaments shimmer across a turquoise pool floor.

label: Blueprint Grid
summary: A technical grid slides across a deep blue plate.

label: Checker Scroll
summary: A two-tone checkerboard scrolls diagonally.

label: Scrolling Stripes
summary: Wide vertical stripes slide steadily sideways.

label: Pulse Rings
summary: Soft rings expand from the centre in a steady rhythm.

label: Bokeh Drift
summary: Out-of-focus lights float lazily over a dark violet backdrop.

label: Spotlight Floor
summary: A soft pool of light on a dark floor that gently breathes.

label: Dawn Sky
summary: A night sky warms into sunrise over six seconds.

label: Sweeping Light
summary: A band of light sweeps repeatedly across a dark slate backdrop.

label: Grainy Wash
summary: A muted diagonal wash with live film grain.

label: Soft Wiggle
summary: The layer wanders gently around its position.

label: Shake
summary: A fast, tight shake of the layer's position.

label: Float
summary: The layer bobs up and down like it floats on water.

label: Sway
summary: The layer sways left and right.

label: Orbit
summary: The layer travels round a circle around its position.

label: Figure Eight
summary: The layer traces a figure eight around its position.

label: Bouncing Ball
summary: The layer bounces up from its position again and again.

label: Drift Right
summary: The layer drifts steadily to the right.

label: Drift Diagonal
summary: The layer drifts slowly down and to the right.

label: Pendulum
summary: The layer swings like a pendulum.

label: Wobble
summary: The layer rotates with an irregular wobble.

label: Spin Slow
summary: The layer rotates once every ten seconds.

label: Spin Fast
summary: The layer rotates twice a second.

label: Pulse
summary: The layer swells and shrinks smoothly.

label: Heartbeat
summary: Two quick beats, then a rest, repeating every second.

label: Breathe
summary: The layer slowly grows and settles back.

label: Rubber Band
summary: Width and height stretch against each other.

label: Jitter Scale
summary: The layer's size jitters randomly.

label: Blink
summary: The layer switches on and off twice a second.

label: Strobe
summary: The layer flashes on for a few frames each beat.

label: Flicker
summary: The layer's opacity flickers like a failing lamp.

label: Fade Pulse
summary: Opacity breathes between full and a third.

label: Typewriter
summary: Characters appear one at a time, hard-edged.

label: Fade Up Characters
summary: Characters fade in while rising into place, left to right.

label: Bounce In Words
summary: Words scale up from nothing with an overshoot, one after another.

label: Tracking In
summary: Widely spaced text tightens up while fading in.

label: Scramble
summary: Letters cycle through random characters before settling, left to right.

label: Blur In
summary: Characters come into focus and fade in, left to right.

label: Jitter
summary: Characters wobble randomly in position and rotation, continuously.

label: Drop In Lines
summary: Lines drop from above with a slight rotation, one after another.
